description: The console's Codex MCP snippet is the bare 3-line server block with no per-tool approval blocks and no warning, while /docs/mcp-tools and /llms.txt give the approval blocks. Anyone copying from the console gets a config where `put` fails under `codex exec`.
expected: Console snippet includes the put/download approval blocks or a link note.
suggested_fix: Use the same snippet as docs/llms.txt in the console panel.

description: Docs and llms.txt sample approves only put and download although seven tools are refused; move, copy, delete, restore and share need hand-written blocks with no example.
expected: Show a generic block or the full list.
suggested_fix: Add one line: repeat the block for each tool name.

description: Starting `agent-drive mcp` prints an unrelated console passphrase notice (`Your account has no account key yet...`) in the launch output.
expected: MCP launch output limited to protocol messages.
suggested_fix: Skip the account-key notice in mcp mode.
